## Description

Trades rates, FX, equity-index or commodity instruments when an economic release deviates from consensus and changes expected policy/growth.

## Where it may fit

Scheduled macro announcements with measurable surprises and clear instrument sensitivity; volatile event windows require robust execution.

## Vehicles

Global macro, FX, rates and event-driven hedge funds.

## Required data

Timestamped macro releases, pre-release consensus forecasts, revision history, release calendar, intraday quotes/trades and instrument sensitivities.

## Caveats

Consensus snapshots and actual release timestamps must be point-in-time; revisions, headline/core distinctions and release-time slippage matter.
